# TOR 12.2 Complaint Stats — 3-Layer Refactor + Monthly Director Report — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace the hardcoded `ComplaintStats.razor` infographic with a 3-layer (Data → Service → UI) architecture seeded from real เล่ม พย68 data, add FR-RPT-009..016, and add a new auto-generated Monthly Director Report page.

**Architecture:** A pure-C# `IComplaintStatsService` generates 560 deterministic synthetic complaint rows (FY2569) whose marginal totals match the source book exactly, then answers one `GetSnapshotAsync(filter)` call returning every view-model the page needs. The Razor page only talks to the interface, so swapping to a real aggregation API later is a one-line DI change. Part B adds a separate `IDirectorReportService` (aggregate constants) feeding a 9-slide print-to-PDF deck; its receiving slide reuses Part A's service.

**Tech Stack:** Blazor WebAssembly (.NET 8), xUnit (new test project), Chart.js 4.4 (already loaded via `analytics.js`), SheetJS (new, for `.xlsx`), scoped CSS.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-07-tor12.2-complaint-stats-refactor-design.md` — all real numbers live in its Appendix 1 & 2.

**Conventions:**
- All commands run from repo root `/Users/thanthita.korn/Desktop/E-CMIS/ecmis-web` unless stated.
- Build the web app with `dotnet build src/EcmisWeb.csproj`.
- Run the app with `dotnet run --project src/EcmisWeb.csproj` then open `http://localhost:5000`.
- Commit after every task.

```csharp
using EcmisWeb.Data;

namespace EcmisWeb.Models;

public record StatRecord(
    int Year,
    DateTime ReceivedAt,
    LegalType Type,
    int ChannelIndex,          // index into ComplaintStatsData.ChannelTotals
    Zone Zone,
    string Province,           // "ไม่ระบุพื้นที่" if not geo-coded
    CaseStatus Status);

public record StatsFilter(
    YearMode YearMode = YearMode.Fiscal,
    int Year = ComplaintStatsData.SeedYear,
    int? CompareYear = null,
    LegalType? Type = null,
    CaseStatus? Status = null,
    Zone? Zone = null,
    string? Province = null,
    DateTime? PeriodFrom = null,
    DateTime? PeriodTo = null)
{
    public static StatsFilter Default => new();
}

public record NamedCount(string Label, int Count);
public record KpiVm(int ReceivedThisYear, int Accumulated, int M62, int M18_4_2, int Other);
public record YearlyTrendVm(IReadOnlyList<NamedCount> Bars, int? CompareYear, int? CompareValue);
public record MonthlyVm(IReadOnlyList<NamedCount> ByMonth, IReadOnlyList<NamedCount> ByQuarter);
public record SectionVm(IReadOnlyList<string> Months, IReadOnlyList<int> M62, IReadOnlyList<int> M18_4);
public record LegalTypeVm(IReadOnlyList<NamedCount> Slices);
public record ChannelVm(IReadOnlyList<NamedCount> All, IReadOnlyList<string> Top5Labels);
public record ZoneVm(IReadOnlyList<NamedCount> ByRegion);

public record StatsSnapshot(
    KpiVm Kpi,
    YearlyTrendVm YearlyTrend,
    MonthlyVm Monthly,
    SectionVm Section,
    LegalTypeVm LegalType,
    ChannelVm Channels,
    ZoneVm Zones,
    IReadOnlyList<NamedCount> TopProvinces,
    IReadOnlyList<StatRecord> Rows,
    DateTime GeneratedAt);
```

```csharp
using EcmisWeb.Data;
using EcmisWeb.Models;
using EcmisWeb.Services;

namespace EcmisWeb.Tests;

public class SeedComplaintStatsServiceTests
{
    private static IReadOnlyList<StatRecord> Rows()
        => new SeedComplaintStatsService().DebugRows;

    [Fact]
    public void Generates_exactly_560_rows()
        => Assert.Equal(560, Rows().Count);

    [Fact]
    public void Monthly_totals_match_book()
    {
        var rows = Rows();
        Assert.Equal(250, rows.Count(r => r.ReceivedAt.Month == 10));
        Assert.Equal(310, rows.Count(r => r.ReceivedAt.Month == 11));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LegalType_marginals_match_book()
    {
        var rows = Rows();
        Assert.Equal(163, rows.Count(r => r.Type == LegalType.M62));
        Assert.Equal(394, rows.Count(r => r.Type == LegalType.M18_4_2));
        Assert.Equal(3, rows.Count(r => r.Type == LegalType.Other));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Zone_counts_sum_to_total()
        => Assert.Equal(560, Rows().Sum(_ => 1));

    [Fact]
    public void Each_zone_count_matches_book()
    {
        var rows = Rows();
        // กอท. carries the +1 "ออกเลขเพิ่ม" row that has no zone in the book
        foreach (var (zone, expected) in ComplaintStatsData.ZoneTotals)
        {
            var allowed = zone == Zone.Kot ? expected + 1 : expected;
            Assert.Equal(allowed, rows.Count(r => r.Zone == zone));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Channel_marginals_match_book()
    {
        var rows = Rows();
        for (var i = 0; i < ComplaintStatsData.ChannelTotals.Length; i++)
            Assert.Equal(ComplaintStatsData.ChannelTotals[i].Total,
                         rows.Count(r => r.ChannelIndex == i));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Province_named_rows_match_constant()
    {
        var expected = Math.Min(ComplaintStatsData.ProvinceTotals.Sum(p => p.Count), 560);
        var named = Rows().Count(r => r.Province != "ไม่ระบุพื้นที่");
        Assert.Equal(expected, named);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Generation_is_deterministic()
    {
        var a = new SeedComplaintStatsService().DebugRows;
        var b = new SeedComplaintStatsService().DebugRows;
        Assert.Equal(a, b);
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the service with generator only (DebugRows)**

Create `src/Services/SeedComplaintStatsService.cs`. `GetSnapshotAsync` is stubbed for now (Task A4 fills it); `DebugRows` exposes the generated rows for tests.

```csharp
using EcmisWeb.Data;
using EcmisWeb.Models;

namespace EcmisWeb.Services;

public sealed class SeedComplaintStatsService : IComplaintStatsService
{
    private readonly List<StatRecord> _rows;

    public SeedComplaintStatsService() => _rows = GenerateRows();

    // exposed for unit tests only
    public IReadOnlyList<StatRecord> DebugRows => _rows;

    public Task<StatsSnapshot> GetSnapshotAsync(StatsFilter filter, CancellationToken ct = default)
        => throw new NotImplementedException();

    private static List<StatRecord> GenerateRows()
    {
        const int total = ComplaintStatsData.SeedTotal; // 560
        var rng = new Random(20690101);                 // fixed seed → deterministic

        // 1) months: 250 Oct (10/2568), 310 Nov (11/2568)
        var months = new List<DateTime>();
        foreach (var (m, y, cnt) in ComplaintStatsData.MonthlyTotals)
            for (var i = 0; i < cnt; i++)
                months.Add(new DateTime(y, m, 1 + (i % 27)));   // spread day 1..27

        // 2) dimension columns, each exactly matching its marginal
        var types     = Expand(ComplaintStatsData.LegalTypeTotals.Select(kv => (kv.Key, kv.Value)), total);
        var statuses  = Expand(ComplaintStatsData.StatusTotals.Select(kv => (kv.Key, kv.Value)), total);
        var channels  = ExpandIndex(ComplaintStatsData.ChannelTotals.Select(c => c.Total), total);

        // zones: book sums to 559 — the 1 "ออกเลขเพิ่ม" row has no zone → fold into กอท. (central)
        var zones = Expand(ComplaintStatsData.ZoneTotals.Select(kv => (kv.Key, kv.Value)), total).Take(total).ToList();
        while (zones.Count < total) zones.Add(Zone.Kot);

        // provinces: book list sums to total (all geo-coded). Take/pad keeps it robust if reconciled later.
        var provinces = ComplaintStatsData.ProvinceTotals
            .SelectMany(p => Enumerable.Repeat(p.Name, p.Count)).Take(total).ToList();
        while (provinces.Count < total) provinces.Add("ไม่ระบุพื้นที่");

        // 3) shuffle each column independently (deterministic) so cross-tabs look mixed
        Shuffle(months, rng); Shuffle(types, rng); Shuffle(zones, rng);
        Shuffle(statuses, rng); Shuffle(channels, rng); Shuffle(provinces, rng);

        // 4) zip
        var rows = new List<StatRecord>(total);
        for (var i = 0; i < total; i++)
            rows.Add(new StatRecord(ComplaintStatsData.SeedYear, months[i], types[i],
                                    channels[i], zones[i], provinces[i], statuses[i]));
        return rows;
    }

    private static List<T> Expand<T>(IEnumerable<(T Key, int Count)> buckets, int total)
    {
        var list = new List<T>(total);
        foreach (var (key, count) in buckets)
            for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) list.Add(key);
        return list;
    }

    private static List<int> ExpandIndex(IEnumerable<int> counts, int total)
    {
        var list = new List<int>(total);
        var idx = 0;
        foreach (var count in counts)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) list.Add(idx);
            idx++;
        }
        return list;
    }

    private static void Shuffle<T>(IList<T> list, Random rng)
    {
        for (var i = list.Count - 1; i > 0; i--)
        {
            var j = rng.Next(i + 1);
            (list[i], list[j]) = (list[j], list[i]);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement `GetSnapshotAsync` and helpers**

In `src/Services/SeedComplaintStatsService.cs`, replace the `GetSnapshotAsync` throw with the implementation below and add the private helpers. Keep the generator code from Task A3.

```csharp
public Task<StatsSnapshot> GetSnapshotAsync(StatsFilter filter, CancellationToken ct = default)
{
    var rows = ApplyFilter(_rows, filter);

    var kpi = new KpiVm(
        ReceivedThisYear: rows.Count,
        Accumulated: ComplaintStatsData.YearlyTotals.Values.Sum(),
        M62: rows.Count(r => r.Type == LegalType.M62),
        M18_4_2: rows.Count(r => r.Type == LegalType.M18_4_2),
        Other: rows.Count(r => r.Type == LegalType.Other));

    var yearlyBars = ComplaintStatsData.YearlyTotals
        .OrderBy(kv => kv.Key)
        .Select(kv => new NamedCount(kv.Key.ToString(), kv.Value))
        .ToList();
    int? cmpVal = filter.CompareYear is int cy && ComplaintStatsData.YearlyTotals.TryGetValue(cy, out var v) ? v : null;
    var yearly = new YearlyTrendVm(yearlyBars, filter.CompareYear, cmpVal);

    var byMonth = rows
        .GroupBy(r => new DateTime(r.ReceivedAt.Year, r.ReceivedAt.Month, 1))
        .OrderBy(g => g.Key)
        .Select(g => new NamedCount(ThaiMonth(g.Key), g.Count()))
        .ToList();
    var byQuarter = rows
        .GroupBy(r => FiscalQuarter(r.ReceivedAt, filter.YearMode))
        .OrderBy(g => g.Key)
        .Select(g => new NamedCount($"ไตรมาส {g.Key}", g.Count()))
        .ToList();
    var monthly = new MonthlyVm(byMonth, byQuarter);

    var section = new SectionVm(
        ComplaintStatsData.MonthlyBySection.Select(s => s.Month).ToList(),
        ComplaintStatsData.MonthlyBySection.Select(s => s.M62Section).ToList(),
        ComplaintStatsData.MonthlyBySection.Select(s => s.M184).ToList());

    var legal = new LegalTypeVm(ComplaintStatsData.LegalTypeTotals
        .Where(kv => kv.Value > 0 || kv.Key is LegalType.M58_2 or LegalType.M18_1Ka)
        .Select(kv => new NamedCount(ComplaintStatsData.LegalTypeLabel(kv.Key),
                                     rows.Count(r => r.Type == kv.Key)))
        .ToList());

    var channelCounts = Enumerable.Range(0, ComplaintStatsData.ChannelTotals.Length)
        .Select(i => new NamedCount(ComplaintStatsData.ChannelTotals[i].Label,
                                    rows.Count(r => r.ChannelIndex == i)))
        .ToList();
    var top5 = channelCounts.Where(c => c.Count > 0)
        .OrderByDescending(c => c.Count).Take(5).Select(c => c.Label).ToList();
    var channels = new ChannelVm(channelCounts, top5);

    var byRegion = rows
        .GroupBy(r => ComplaintStatsData.ToRegion(r.Zone))
        .OrderBy(g => g.Key)
        .Select(g => new NamedCount(ComplaintStatsData.RegionLabel(g.Key), g.Count()))
        .ToList();
    var zones = new ZoneVm(byRegion);

    var topProvinces = rows
        .Where(r => r.Province != "ไม่ระบุพื้นที่")
        .GroupBy(r => r.Province)
        .Select(g => new NamedCount(g.Key, g.Count()))
        .OrderByDescending(p => p.Count).ThenBy(p => p.Label)
        .ToList();

    var snapshot = new StatsSnapshot(kpi, yearly, monthly, section, legal, channels, zones,
                                     topProvinces, rows, DateTime.Now);
    return Task.FromResult(snapshot);
}

private static List<StatRecord> ApplyFilter(IEnumerable<StatRecord> src, StatsFilter f)
{
    var (from, to) = YearRange(f.YearMode, f.Year);
    if (f.PeriodFrom is { } pf && pf > from) from = pf;
    if (f.PeriodTo is { } pt && pt < to) to = pt;

    return src.Where(r =>
        r.ReceivedAt >= from && r.ReceivedAt <= to &&
        (f.Type is null || r.Type == f.Type) &&
        (f.Status is null || r.Status == f.Status) &&
        (f.Zone is null || r.Zone == f.Zone) &&
        (f.Province is null || r.Province == f.Province))
        .ToList();
}

private static (DateTime From, DateTime To) YearRange(YearMode mode, int beYear) =>
    mode == YearMode.Fiscal
        ? (new DateTime(beYear - 1, 10, 1), new DateTime(beYear, 9, 30, 23, 59, 59))
        : (new DateTime(beYear, 1, 1), new DateTime(beYear, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59));

private static int FiscalQuarter(DateTime d, YearMode mode)
{
    if (mode == YearMode.Calendar) return (d.Month - 1) / 3 + 1;
    var m = (d.Month + 2) % 12 + 1;      // Oct→1 ... Sep→12 within fiscal year
    return (m - 1) / 3 + 1;
}

private static string ThaiMonth(DateTime d)
{
    string[] m = { "ม.ค.", "ก.พ.", "มี.ค.", "เม.ย.", "พ.ค.", "มิ.ย.",
                   "ก.ค.", "ส.ค.", "ก.ย.", "ต.ค.", "พ.ย.", "ธ.ค." };
    return $"{m[d.Month - 1]} {d.Year}";
}
```

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the JS helper file**

Create `src/wwwroot/js/complaint-stats.js`. Reuses Chart.js (already loaded). `initRegionMap` draws a horizontal bar "map" of regions; `exportStatsXlsx` builds a multi-sheet `.xlsx` via SheetJS (`XLSX` global).

```javascript
// Region "map" — horizontal bar by ปปท. region + ส่วนกลาง
window.csZoneChart = null;
window.initRegionMap = function (canvasId, labels, data, isDark) {
    if (window.csZoneChart) { window.csZoneChart.destroy(); window.csZoneChart = null; }
    const el = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!el || !window.Chart) return;
    const tick = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.55)' : '#475569';
    const grid = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.06)' : 'rgba(13,27,62,.07)';
    window.csZoneChart = new Chart(el.getContext('2d'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels, datasets: [{ data, backgroundColor: '#26408b', borderRadius: 4 }] },
        options: {
            indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, animation: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
            scales: {
                x: { grid: { color: grid }, ticks: { color: tick } },
                y: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: tick } }
            }
        }
    });
};

// Excel export via SheetJS — sheets: [{name, aoa:[[..],[..]]}]
window.exportStatsXlsx = function (fileName, sheets) {
    if (!window.XLSX) { alert('ไม่พบไลบรารี Excel'); return; }
    const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    sheets.forEach(s => {
        const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(s.aoa);
        XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, s.name.substring(0, 31));
    });
    XLSX.writeFile(wb, fileName);
};
```

```razor
@code {
    private bool _isDark = true;
    private bool _quarterView;
    private int _secondsAgo;
    private StatsFilter _filter = StatsFilter.Default;
    private StatsSnapshot? _snap;
    private System.Threading.Timer? _timer;
    private DotNetObjectReference<ComplaintStats>? _dotNetRef;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync() => await ReloadAsync();

    protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            var theme = await JS.InvokeAsync<string?>("localStorage.getItem", "dashTheme");
            _isDark = theme != "light";
            _dotNetRef = DotNetObjectReference.Create(this);
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("registerAnalyticsComponent", _dotNetRef);
            // FR-009 auto-refresh every 30s
            _timer = new System.Threading.Timer(async _ => await InvokeAsync(TickAsync), null, 30000, 30000);
        }
        if (_snap is not null) await RenderChartsAsync();
    }

    private async Task TickAsync() { await ReloadAsync(); }

    private async Task ReloadAsync()
    {
        _snap = await Stats.GetSnapshotAsync(_filter);
        _secondsAgo = 0;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    [JSInvokable] public async Task OnThemeChangedAsync(bool isDark)
    { _isDark = isDark; await RenderChartsAsync(); }

    private async Task RenderChartsAsync()
    {
        if (_snap is null) return;
        var chColors = new[] { "#6366f1","#06d6a0","#f77f00","#f87171","#a855f7","#00bcd4","#fb923c","#4ade80","#ec4899","#8b5cf6","#14b8a6","#3b82f6","#f59e0b","#94a3b8","#ef4444","#22c55e","#eab308","#0ea5e9","#64748b" };
        var ch = _snap.Channels.All.Where(c => c.Count > 0).ToArray();
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initAnalyticsChart", "csiChannel", "doughnut",
            ch.Select(c => c.Label).ToArray(), ch.Select(c => (object)c.Count).ToArray(), chColors, _isDark);

        var lg = _snap.LegalType.Slices.ToArray();
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initAnalyticsChart", "csiLegal", "doughnut",
            lg.Select(c => c.Label).ToArray(), lg.Select(c => (object)c.Count).ToArray(),
            new[] { "#7e3ca8","#26408b","#06d6a0","#f59e0b","#94a3b8" }, _isDark);

        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initRegionMap", "csiRegion",
            _snap.Zones.ByRegion.Select(r => r.Label).ToArray(),
            _snap.Zones.ByRegion.Select(r => (object)r.Count).ToArray(), _isDark);

        var mv = _quarterView ? _snap.Monthly.ByQuarter : _snap.Monthly.ByMonth;
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initAnalyticsChart", "csiMonthly", "bar",
            mv.Select(m => m.Label).ToArray(), mv.Select(m => (object)m.Count).ToArray(),
            (object?)null, _isDark);

        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initGroupedBarChart", "csiSection", _snap.Section.Months.ToArray(),
            new object[]
            {
                new { label = "ม.62/พรบ.", data = _snap.Section.M62.Cast<object>().ToArray(), backgroundColor = "#ef4444" },
                new { label = "ม.18/4", data = _snap.Section.M18_4.Cast<object>().ToArray(), backgroundColor = "#06d6a0" }
            }, _isDark);

        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("initCsiTrendBar", "csiTrend",
            _snap.YearlyTrend.Bars.Select(b => b.Label).ToArray(),
            _snap.YearlyTrend.Bars.Select(b => (object)b.Count).ToArray(),
            _snap.YearlyTrend.Bars.Select(b => b.Label == "2569" ? "#06d6a0" : b.Label == "2568" ? "#6366f1" : "#4a5568").ToArray(),
            _isDark);
    }

    private async Task SetYearMode(YearMode m) { _filter = _filter with { YearMode = m }; await ReloadAsync(); }
    private async Task OnTypeChanged(ChangeEventArgs e) { _filter = _filter with { Type = Parse<LegalType>(e.Value?.ToString()) }; await ReloadAsync(); }
    private async Task OnStatusChanged(ChangeEventArgs e) { _filter = _filter with { Status = Parse<CaseStatus>(e.Value?.ToString()) }; await ReloadAsync(); }
    private async Task OnZoneChanged(ChangeEventArgs e) { _filter = _filter with { Zone = Parse<Zone>(e.Value?.ToString()) }; await ReloadAsync(); }
    private async Task ClearFilter() { _filter = StatsFilter.Default; await ReloadAsync(); }
    private async Task ToggleQuarter() { _quarterView = !_quarterView; await RenderChartsAsync(); }

    private static T? Parse<T>(string? v) where T : struct, Enum
        => Enum.TryParse<T>(v, out var r) ? r : null;

    private async Task ExportExcelAsync()
    {
        if (_snap is null) return;
        var sheets = new object[]
        {
            new { name = "KPI", aoa = new object[][]
            {
                new object[] { "ตัวชี้วัด", "ค่า" },
                new object[] { "รับปี 2569", _snap.Kpi.ReceivedThisYear },
                new object[] { "สะสม", _snap.Kpi.Accumulated },
                new object[] { "ม.62", _snap.Kpi.M62 },
                new object[] { "ม.18/4(2)", _snap.Kpi.M18_4_2 },
            }},
            new { name = "ช่องทาง", aoa = _snap.Channels.All
                .Select(c => new object[] { c.Label, c.Count })
                .Prepend(new object[] { "ช่องทาง", "จำนวน" }).ToArray() },
            new { name = "จังหวัด", aoa = _snap.TopProvinces
                .Select(p => new object[] { p.Label, p.Count })
                .Prepend(new object[] { "จังหวัด", "จำนวน" }).ToArray() },
        };
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("exportStatsXlsx", $"complaint-stats-{ComplaintStatsData.SeedYear}.xlsx", sheets);
    }

    private async Task PrintAsync() => await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("window.print");

    public void Dispose() { _timer?.Dispose(); _dotNetRef?.Dispose(); }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create the seed service**

Create `src/Services/SeedDirectorReportService.cs`. Slide-2 receiving compare uses book constants now; the `IComplaintStatsService` dependency is wired so a later version can pull the live current-year figure.

```csharp
using EcmisWeb.Data;
using EcmisWeb.Models;

namespace EcmisWeb.Services;

public sealed class SeedDirectorReportService(IComplaintStatsService stats) : IDirectorReportService
{
    private readonly IComplaintStatsService _stats = stats;

    public Task<DirectorReportSnapshot> GetSnapshotAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var snap = new DirectorReportSnapshot(
            ReportMonth: DirectorReportData.ReportMonth,
            AsOf: DirectorReportData.AsOf,
            Prev: new YearCompare(DirectorReportData.Prev2568.M62, DirectorReportData.Prev2568.M184, DirectorReportData.Prev2568.Total),
            Cur:  new YearCompare(DirectorReportData.Cur2569.M62, DirectorReportData.Cur2569.M184, DirectorReportData.Cur2569.Total),
            YoYPercent: DirectorReportData.YoYPercent,
            Inquiry: DirectorReportData.Inquiry.Select(z => new ZoneCaseRow(z.Zone, z.V)).ToList(),
            InquiryTotal: DirectorReportData.InquiryTotal,
            Merit: DirectorReportData.Merit.Select(z => new ZoneCaseRow(z.Zone, z.V)).ToList(),
            MeritTotal: DirectorReportData.MeritTotal,
            PostResolution: DirectorReportData.PostResolution.Select(p => new LabeledValue(p.Label, p.Value)).ToList(),
            CourtProgress: DirectorReportData.CourtProgress.Select(p => new LabeledValue(p.Label, p.Value)).ToList(),
            BudgetTotal: DirectorReportData.BudgetTotal,
            BudgetUsed: DirectorReportData.BudgetUsed,
            BudgetRemain: DirectorReportData.BudgetRemain);
        return Task.FromResult(snap);
    }
}
```

```razor
                new[] { "ใช้ไป", "คงเหลือ" },
                new object[] { _s.BudgetUsed, _s.BudgetRemain },
                new[] { "#2f8fd6", "#e08a2b" }, false);
    }

    private RenderFragment KpiGrid(int[] t) => builder =>
    {
        // t = [m62done,m62remain,m184done,m184remain,totalDone,totalRemain]
        builder.AddMarkupContent(0, $@"
          <div class='mdr-kgrid'>
            <div class='kh lbl'>ประเภทตามมาตรา</div><div class='kh done'>แล้วเสร็จ</div><div class='kh remain'>คงเหลือ</div>
            <div class='kc cat'>ตาม ม.62 / พรบ.</div><div class='kc num'>{t[0]}</div><div class='kc num'>{t[1]}</div>
            <div class='kc cat'>ตาม ม.18/4</div><div class='kc num'>{t[2]}</div><div class='kc num'>{t[3]}</div>
            <div class='kc cat tot'>รวมทั้งหมด</div><div class='kc num tot'>{t[4]}</div><div class='kc num tot'>{t[5]}</div>
          </div>");
    };

    private RenderFragment ZoneTable(IReadOnlyList<ZoneCaseRow> rows, int[] total) => builder =>
    {
        var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
        sb.Append(@"<table class='mdr-utbl'><thead><tr><th>หน่วยงาน</th>
          <th class='g1'>ม.62<br>เสร็จ</th><th class='g2'>คงเหลือ</th>
          <th class='g1'>ม.18/4<br>เสร็จ</th><th class='g2'>คงเหลือ</th>
          <th class='g1'>รวมเสร็จ</th><th class='g2'>รวมคงเหลือ</th></tr></thead><tbody>");
        foreach (var r in rows)
            sb.Append($"<tr><td>{r.Zone}</td><td>{r.Values[0]}</td><td>{r.Values[1]}</td><td>{r.Values[2]}</td><td>{r.Values[3]}</td><td>{r.Values[4]}</td><td>{r.Values[5]}</td></tr>");
        sb.Append($"<tr class='t'><td>รวม</td><td>{total[0]}</td><td>{total[1]}</td><td>{total[2]}</td><td>{total[3]}</td><td>{total[4]}</td><td>{total[5]}</td></tr>");
        sb.Append("</tbody></table>");
        builder.AddMarkupContent(0, sb.ToString());
    };

    private async Task PrintAsync() => await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("window.print");
}
```

```css
.mdr-bar { position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50; background:#1c1c2e; color:#fff; padding:11px 22px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:16px; }

.mdr-cover { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center; }
.mdr-em { width:70px; height:70px; border-radius:50%; border:3px solid #1b2a5b; color:#1b2a5b; display:grid; place-items:center; font-weight:800; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:18px; }
.mdr-cover h1 { font-size:36px; font-weight:800; color:#1b2a5b; }
.mdr-month { font-size:22px; font-weight:700; color:#7a1f2b; margin-top:14px; }
.mdr-dept { font-size:16px; margin-top:6px; }
.mdr-cmp { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:28px; }
.mdr-card { border:1px solid #d9dce4; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; }
.mdr-card .ch { padding:13px 18px; color:#fff; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
.mdr-card.prev .ch { background:#7a1f2b; } .mdr-card.cur .ch { background:#1b2a5b; }
.mdr-card .badge { background:rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-radius:20px; padding:2px 10px; font-size:11.5px; }

.mdr-card td { padding:12px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid #d9dce4; font-size:16px; }
.mdr-card td:last-child { text-align:right; font-weight:700; font-size:20px; color:#1b2a5b; }
.mdr-card tr.t td { background:#f3ead6; } .mdr-card tr.t td:last-child { color:#7a1f2b; font-size:22px; }
.mdr-yoy { margin-top:14px; text-align:center; background:#eafaf2; border:1px solid #bfe8d4; border-radius:12px; padding:11px; }
.mdr-yoy b { font-size:24px; color:#1f9d6b; }
.mdr-kgrid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr; border:1px solid #d9dce4; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; }
.mdr-kgrid .kh { padding:13px 16px; font-weight:800; color:#fff; text-align:center; }
.mdr-kgrid .kh.lbl { background:#f6f7fa; color:#1b2a5b; text-align:left; }
.mdr-kgrid .kh.done { background:#e08a2b; } .mdr-kgrid .kh.remain { background:#2f8fd6; }
.mdr-kgrid .kc { padding:16px; border-top:1px solid #d9dce4; }
.mdr-kgrid .kc.cat { font-weight:700; background:#fafbfd; }
.mdr-kgrid .kc.num { text-align:center; font-size:28px; font-weight:800; }
.mdr-kgrid .cat.tot, .mdr-kgrid .num.tot { background:#f3ead6; color:#7a1f2b; }
.mdr-utbl { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12px; }
.mdr-utbl th, .mdr-utbl td { border:1px solid #d9dce4; padding:5px 7px; text-align:center; }
.mdr-utbl thead th { background:#1b2a5b; color:#fff; }
.mdr-utbl thead th.g1 { background:#e08a2b; } .mdr-utbl thead th.g2 { background:#2f8fd6; }
.mdr-utbl td:first-child { text-align:left; font-weight:700; background:#fafbfd; }
.mdr-utbl tr.t td { background:#f3ead6; font-weight:800; color:#7a1f2b; }
.mdr-flow { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; max-width:62%; }

.mdr-fbox .v { font-weight:800; }
.mdr-side { position:absolute; right:50px; top:120px; width:240px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; }

.mdr-budtop { text-align:center; background:#f3ead6; border:1px solid #b8923f; border-radius:30px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:14px; font-size:16px; }
.mdr-budrow { font-size:15px; margin:6px 0; } .mdr-budrow .sw { display:inline-block; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:4px; margin-right:8px; vertical-align:middle; }

.mdr-chart { height:280px; margin-top:14px; }

.mdr-scope th, .mdr-scope td { border:1px solid #d9dce4; padding:8px 10px; text-align:left; }

.mdr-scope .ok { color:#1f9d6b; font-weight:700; } .mdr-scope .wait { color:#6b7280; }

@media print {
  .mdr-bar { display:none; }
  .mdr-slide { margin:0; box-shadow:none; width:297mm; min-height:200mm; page-break-after:always; }
  @page { size:A4 landscape; margin:8mm; }
}
```
